November 6, 2026

Stephen Miller to replace Susie Wiles as White House chief of staff

tags: politics, government
sources: @oafnation_actual

President Trump announced on Friday that Stephen Miller will become White House chief of staff beginning Monday, November 9, with Susie Wiles moving to the Trump Political Operation. Wiles said Friday was her last day in the role, and reporting indicates she submitted her resignation Thursday night. She was Trump's longest-serving chief of staff and the first woman to hold the position. The change follows the midterm losses and days of public calls from Republicans for her to step down.
